bestBets.overview: SUPAROO is bursting to win a race. He has been finding the line strongly and gives every indication the rise in trip will suit. SIN CITY BOY looks the logical danger on the back of consecutive placings over the staying trip. HE'SNOTALLTHERE has run in his last two starts and has claims. PEMBETON should beat most of these on ability alone.

raceTips.comment: Sin City Boy was made to drag back last start and really couldn’t have done much more the way he finished off in trying to reel in the leaders. If he can utilise the gate here today he’s been afforded and have an unimpeded passage in transit he should really prove hard to beat. He’snotallthere has proven to be a pretty honest little conveyance who rolls forward and doesn’t lie down, perfect sort of a horse for the Pontiff and a maiden win looks right on the doorstep. Suparoo can really wind up and finish off and is racing like he’s looking for this trip. By God He Is looks very dour but has a lot more upside than most of these who are very well exposed, booking of Pike certainly helps too.

bestBets.overview: ROCKTEX found the line strongly first-up. He improves off that run and will appreciate the the rise in trip. CASSANDRA has showed ability in her trials and W Pike rides. CHANTATIOUS resumes from a spell with the benefit of two nice trial efforts. AURA MAGNA improves off her first-up run and will appreciate the drop in class.

raceTips.comment: Rocktex looks to have this race at his mercy, at least of those gallopers that have had a start on race-day. Really liked the way he finished off strongly at Northam on return behind Lake Baikal and Clear Assault in the inferior part of the track on the day and 1300m off that may well really suit him for a firing Trevor Andrews operation, love the way his team is ticking along. Cassandra has trialled stylishly for team Williams leading into her debut, looks as though she’ll stretch out over a bit of ground in time so I don’t mind the 1300m kick-off. Rocky Beach is a filly going better than her race form suggests, got some ability but the draw hurts. Aura Magna had excuses on return but does draw a little sticky here, should find this race easier.

bestBets.overview: ABOUT TURN did a good job first-up after he was caught wide throughout. He should derive plenty of benefit from that hit-out, draws the inside gate and Jarrad Noske goes on for an apprentice. ZERO TO SIXTY will park off the speed and find the line well. DIAMOND CHOUX should be peaking at her third run back from a spell. TANUNDA rolls forward and has claims.

raceTips.comment: About Turn did a mountain of work first up on return off the back of a nice trial and never packed it in. Can box-seat here under the senior hoop who knows him well and in what is a shocking maiden depth-wise, put his first win on the board. Zero To Sixty’s form has been patchy this prep but if he run up to three starts ago where he ran 3rd to Bookends and Dirty Habits he’d be well and truly in the game here. Pure’n’Simple was beaten 5L in a 3YO 0MW last prep by Wonderfully Made and 4L by subsequent Lex Piper winner The Crimson Pirate a start later, not bad form at all for a maiden of this depth and is out of a race first up that rated quite well. Tanunda rolls forward and was good two starts ago, regressed last start.

bestBets.overview: ATSUI HARU has run well in both her career starts. She will appreciate the rise in trip and should get every chance from her good draw. TRICKSTER has ability and W Pike retains the ride. He will park midfield and find the line we;. HISTORY SUPREME battled on well at his debut. He improves off that run and has claims. ENERGETIC next best.

raceTips.comment: Atsui Haru the way we’ll go with the weight pull he gets on Pike’s mount here off a really solid effort at Bunbury at career start #2 last time out. Worked home like a horse who would appreciate a mile, draws beautifully in 4 and with just a featherweight 50.5kgs on his back should be very strong at the business end. Trickster is also still on the up and ran a very good race into the placings on that same Bunbury program still a bit green but has a motor and importantly Pike sticks. Sylva Jack wasn’t suited at all back to 1400m last start, much better placement here. History Supreme a watch, big, raw lump of a horse who raced very green on debut but showed a glimpse of something for a trainer who can get them up and rolling early in JK Racing.

bestBets.overview: This looks a nice assignment for TRIPLE THE CHANT. He found the line well last start in a collectively better race than this. The small field suits and he should be hard to hold out. PUBLICISE looks very to another win. She finished off strongly last start and looks suited with the rise to a mile. LATE ARRIVAL attacks this off a strong last start win where he parked on the speed and found plenty late. ROSIE CAN RUN next best.

raceTips.comment: Publicise’s last two have been enormous and the way she hit the line last start in Saturday company at 1400m behind a very talented 4YO in Heaven Specified, particularly now with the key scratching of Triple The Chant, she’ll be very hard to beat in this back to a mile. Chantel is back off her run last start, wildly tough given the extra ground she covered and if the day has proven to be on-speed by this stage, she’ll start shorter than $6.50, hard to get past if afforded the opportunity of leading and dictating. Late Arrival toughed out a strong win second up staving off a diving Poblano. Mile could even suit him better and he’s not only tough but also versatile. Rosie Can Run broke a long run of outs last start and the figures out of the race were very strong with the second horse Phat Chaps a subsequent winner as well to frank it.

bestBets.overview: This looks a big drop in grade for KELORA. He looks well in after claim for the apprentice Jason Li and if he brings his best form he takes plenty of beating. MILITARY JANE has been racing well all preparation and has claims. COSMIC ECLIPSE is a previous winner at this track and has claims. MISS WALL STREET next best.

raceTips.comment: Kelora couldn’t be better placed under the 3kg claim of Jason Li back into 46+ company given he’s a previous Saturday Westspeed winner who has been going around solely in Graduation & 66+ contests of late. Only 3 starts ago was beaten 2L in a Graduation behind Diamonds’n’rubies, outstanding form for this, just needs the right run/steer from the wide draw. Cosmic Eclipse is going really well, her run two back would be good enough to win this and love the jockey change, CJP should really suit the kind of horse that she is. Angel’s My Name showed big improvement last start and always needs a few runs to come up to the mark fitness wise, if she can find the front and control she can give a stack of cheek particularly if it’s on speed. Miss Wall Street is always a chance with the right flowing run in these sort of races.

bestBets.overview: COSMO RULER attacks this off a five week let-up. She's a talented and emerging mare and think she will take plenty of beating. CABLE ROCK rolls forward and if he repeats his last start effort he can give a big sight on the speed. JAVELIN STRIKE has ability and attacks this first-up without a trial. RADIANT LIGHT rolls forward and has claims.

raceTips.comment: Come On Emma is a very consistent mare who arguably goes best fresh and ran a cracker in CL3 company first up last campaign. Resumes in a CL1 here with a map and goes around each-way as a mare you need each-way to be backing, good race for her to run well. Radiant Light can kick through to lead and had excuses last start after being made to do a mountain of work. Cable Rock is also very consistent but lacks that killer blow. The Scholar was disappointing first up but Tony Triscari's can bounce very quickly.
